`ShapeIndex` serialization support has been implemented on a new branch `feature/shapeindex-encode`.

### Key Changes Made

1. **`ShapeIndex` Serialization (`[s2/shapeindex.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-rpxn4_v8/s2/shapeindex.go)`)**:
   - Added `Encode(w io.Writer) error` and `Decode(r io.Reader) error` to `ShapeIndex`.
   - `Encode` applies any pending updates via `s.maybeApplyUpdates()` before serialization, ensuring spatial index cells (`cellMap` and `cells`) are generated and preserved even if `Build()` was not explicitly called.
   - Encodes shape metadata (`nextID`, `maxEdgesPerCell`), shape list by shape ID, cell IDs, and `clippedShape` structures (`containsCenter`, `edges`).
   - `Decode` reconstructs `shapes`, `cellMap`, `cells`, and sets `status` to `fresh` so iteration, point queries, and spatial queries work immediately without calling `Build()`.
   - Preserves sparse shape IDs when shapes have been removed, ensuring cell edge references remain valid.

2. **Built-in `Shape` Types Encoding & Decoding**:
   - Implemented `Encode` and `Decode` methods for `PointVector` ([`point_vector.go`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-rpxn4_v8/s2/point_vector.go)), `LaxPolyline` ([`lax_polyline.go`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-rpxn4_v8/s2/lax_polyline.go)), `LaxPolygon` ([`lax_polygon.go`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-rpxn4_v8/s2/lax_polygon.go)), and `LaxLoop` ([`lax_loop.go`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-rpxn4_v8/s2/lax_loop.go)).
   - Registered type tags in `s2/shape.go` for all built-in `Shape` types (`Polygon`, `Polyline`, `PointVector`, `LaxPolyline`, `LaxPolygon`, `LaxLoop`, `Loop`).
   - Handled zero-edge shapes, full polygons, and shapes with mixed chain counts.

3. **Robust Error Handling**:
   - Added validation against corrupt bytes, truncated input, invalid CellIDs, invalid shape/edge IDs, and oversized allocation requests.
   - Included a `recover` safety net in `Decode` to return errors instead of panicking on malformed inputs.

4. **Testing (`[s2/shapeindex_encode_test.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-rpxn4_v8/s2/shapeindex_encode_test.go)`)**:
   - Added comprehensive tests covering empty index round-tripping, all built-in shape types, sparse shape IDs, decoding without explicit `Build()`, zero-edge shapes, mixed chain counts, and malformed inputs.
